name: Zentreya
title: The Red Devil
description: Zentreya is a roleplayer, streamer, and VTuber who was the leader and founder of the [Anti-Lewd Army](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Anti-Lewd_Army), a prominent VRChat community faction, earning the nickname 'The Red Devil.' Portrayed as a demon who evolved from a demon-human hybrid into a demon-dragon persona, she is remembered in community lore as a strong-willed, strategic leader with a warmer side beneath a tough exterior. She has since become a well-known independent VTuber on platforms like Twitch and YouTube.
